    """Return extra kwargs for apply_chat_template based on model type.
    Qwen3 requires enable_thinking=False to suppress thinking mode;
    other models (e.g. Llama) don't support this parameter."""
    name = getattr(tokenizer, 'name_or_path', '').lower()
    if 'qwen' in name:
        return {'enable_thinking': False}
    return {}

'''
